bank-1401.title: SOS in international Morse code #1
bank-1401.description: Distress signal 'SOS' in international Morse (sound) alphabet. the Morse is formed of 'dit' and 'dah' (of points and features). 1 'dah' equals 3 'dit'. The spaces between the letters are equivalent to 1 'dah', except for the SOS, which must be sent as if it were a single letter, that is to say not using an inter-letter interval. Ends with a space between the words equivalent to 7 'dit'. Realized on a computer with a sine wave of 440 Hz. For more information on Morse: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Morse_code
bank-1401.author: Joseph Sardin
